title: Claude built a free browser game where an entire planet (and its music) is generated from whatever name you give it. Today I finally added oceans life!
author: niklasdaking
selftext:
Hey all! **Worldseed** is a free browser Open World Sandbox Adventure Game set on a procedurally generated planet.

Just dropped **v51: The Sea, and the Songs**!

* **Oceans & Boats:** Hop on local fishing boats to haul nets, or hire skippers to find hidden islands and shipwrecks.
* **Sea Life:** Dolphins, seals, whales, and pearl diving off warm coasts.
* **Music:** Play along with tavern bards on a 5-note pipe to earn coins and learn utility tunes (or learn some magical tunes).

🎮 **Play free right now in your browser:**  [https://generic-king.itch.io/worldseed](https://generic-king.itch.io/worldseed)

Feedback is super welcome!
